content: Create an open top box (220x300x160mm) with wall thickness of 8mm and bottom thickness of 12mm. | Now i want you to execute the prepared function calls one after the other. If you need to do some calculations or geometrical algebra, use the CreateCode Function first. Execute the first prepared function call. Submit all required variables at once

function_call.name: CreateCode
function_call.arguments: "{\"PythonCode\":\"# Calculate the outer dimensions of the box\\nouter_x = 220\\nouter_y = 300\\nouter_z = 160\\n\\n# Calculate the inner dimensions by subtracting twice the wall thickness (for x and y) and the bottom thickness (for z)\\ninner_x = outer_x - 2 * 8\\ninner_y = outer_y - 2 * 8\\ninner_z = outer_z - 12\\n\\n# Calculate the position of the inner box to center it within the outer box\\ninner_x_pos = (outer_x - inner_x) / 2\\ninner_y_pos = (outer_y - inner_y) / 2\\ninner_z_pos = outer_z - inner_z\\n\\n# Output the results\\nouter_x, outer_y, outer_z, inner_x, inner_y, inner_z, inner_x_pos, inner_y_pos, inner_z_pos\"}"

content:
{"PythonCode":"# Calculate the outer dimensions of the box
outer_x = 220
outer_y = 300
outer_z = 160

# Calculate the inner dimensions by subtracting twice the wall thickness (for x and y) and the bottom thickness (for z)
inner_x = outer_x - 2 * 8
inner_y = outer_y - 2 * 8
inner_z = outer_z - 12

# Calculate the position of the inner box to center it within the outer box
inner_x_pos = (outer_x - inner_x) / 2
inner_y_pos = (outer_y - inner_y) / 2
inner_z_pos = outer_z - inner_z

# Output the results
outer_x, outer_y, outer_z, inner_x, inner_y, inner_z, inner_x_pos, inner_y_pos, inner_z_pos"}
